procedure_summary: The methyl ester of the bromomethyl arylsulfonyl benzoate is cleaved with base by the same procedure as the earlier example, giving the sodium carboxylate salt with the benzylic bromide intact. This section prints only the cross-reference and the content of the salt obtained, with no charges, conditions or workup of its own.

procedure_text: 向反应釜中加入70mLDMF、12.9g  2-四氢呋喃甲醇(99％，0.125mol)和26.1g氢氧化钾溶液(30％，0.14mol)，开动搅拌，控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(98.2％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为2h，加毕保温反应4h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至2，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物32.6g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为94.8％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率88.8％。
procedure_summary: The sodium benzoate salt from the preceding step is added portionwise, in the cold, to tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol and aqueous potassium hydroxide in N,N-dimethylformamide, and the alkoxide displaces the benzylic bromide to form the ether. The solvent is then stripped under reduced pressure, the kettle residue is dissolved in water and acidified with concentrated hydrochloric acid, and the precipitated free acid is filtered, rinsed with water and dried.
